description:
On his lonely birthday, he makes a wish on an old family talisman — *“Please let me meet someone I can love.”*

Moments later, a man appears at his door, holding a cake.

*“Don’t fall for me. That feeling… it’s fake. The charm made it.”  
“You made the wish. So now, you’re responsible for it.”*

A fateful meeting bound by a charm... but is their love really just magic, or something real that bloomed in its wake?
